name: FA_TRX_REFERENCES
description: FA_TRX_REFERENCES contains information about inter-asset transactions where two or more dependent transactions are performed at one time.  Oracle Fusion Assets inserts rows in this table and in the FA_TRANSACTION_HEADERS table each time you perform such a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction reference which links transactions involving multiple assets.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Classification of the inter-asset transaction.

columns.name: SRC_TRANSACTION_SUBTYPE
columns.description: Further detail of the transaction type for source asset.

columns.name: DEST_TRANSACTION_SUBTYPE
columns.description: Further detail of the transaction type for destination asset.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: DEST_BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique destination book identification name.

columns.name: SRC_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the source asset on which the transaction occurred.

columns.name: SRC_TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the source transaction.

columns.name: DEST_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the destination asset on which the transaction occurred.

columns.name: DEST_TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the destination transaction.

columns.name: MEMBER_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identification number of the member asset.

columns.name: MEMBER_TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the member asset transaction which spawned this transaction for the group asset.

columns.name: SRC_AMORTIZATION_START_DATE
columns.description: Amortization start date for the source asset transaction.

columns.name: DEST_AMORTIZATION_START_DATE
columns.description: Amortization start date for the destination asset transaction.

columns.name: RESERVE_TRANSFER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Reserve amount transferred between assets.

columns.name: SRC_EXPENSE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount entered for catch-up depreciation expense on the source asset transaction.

columns.name: DEST_EXPENSE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount entered for catch-up depreciation expense on the destination asset transaction.

columns.name: SRC_EOFY_RESERVE
columns.description: Amount entered for the reserve of the prior fiscal year for the source asset.

columns.name: DEST_EOFY_RESERVE
columns.description: Depreciation reserve of the destination asset at the end of the previous fiscal year.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction event which is associated with this row for accounting purposes.

columns.name: INVOICE_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the invoice transaction.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
